# Draft:530 Howard Street

----
530 Howard Street is a residential skyscraper approved in the South of Market area in San Francisco, California.
History
530 Howard Street was proposed by Bayhill Ventures on November, 2023.It was recently approved for construction on October, 2024. The skyscraper is 72 Stories tall and 840 feet tall, which would make it the third tallest building in San Francisco. When constructed will have 672 apartments, 68 of which will be affordable housing.
